question.text: The breakeven point (BEP) for a long call option buyer is calculated as:

explanation.text: The Logic: Call BEP = Strike Price + Premium Paid At BEP, the option payoff exactly equals the premium paid, resulting in zero profit/loss. Example: Strike = 17,500, Premium = 200 BEP = 17,500 + 200 = 17,700 At spot 17,700: Payoff = 17,700 - 17,500 = 200 = Premium paid. Net P/L = 0. The Trap: Put BEP = Strike - Premium (opposite direction). Don't confuse the two. Cross-Exam Context: BEP questions are among the most frequently asked calculation questions. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Call BEP = X + P. Put BEP = X - P.
